title: Expected value of a randomized CSP input
statement: Given a constraint template over a finite label set and a finite randomized constraint satisfaction input for that template, its expected value is the expected payoff of the randomized assignment when the payoff of each assignment is the number of satisfied constraints divided by the total number of constraints, with multiplicity counted.
hypotheses_covered: Constraint template over that label set
